properties.digitization_method: ADDED 2026-09-18 for Mission Bay's North-blocks pass: real OSM building footprint, a multipolygon with two small interior courtyard/light-well holes preserved rather than filled in. 255 Berry -- a Signature Properties condo building, built 2004, informally 'Signature I' to 235 Berry St's 'Signature II' (see that file's note on naming). 2026-09-29 accuracy audit: (1) The developer is Signature Development Group, not 'Signature Properties', and its project page (signaturedevelopment.com/development/255-berry/) gives a development date range of 2001-2004 rather than a built year; neither is in the cited OSM relation. It describes 255 Berry as an 'eco-chic condominium development ... 99 lofts and condominium units'. (2) The informal 'Signature I' / 'Signature II' naming is withdrawn: no cited source uses it. 2026-10-02: public-text pass. accuracy_caveat reworded for readers (meaning unchanged; no change to the shape, status, use or geometry_type); previous wording -- accuracy_caveat: 'REAL -- surveyed OpenStreetMap building footprint(s), not a hand trace or plan estimate. The underlying Assessor parcel is condo-mapped across many individually owned per-unit lots (confirmed against data/raw/parcels.geojson), so no single blklot represents the whole building and it cannot be joined via status.csv the way a single-owner parcel can. Using the real building footprint from OSM instead of a fabricated or arbitrarily chosen 'representative' unit lot, the same pattern already used for Mission Bay's other condo-mapped residential towers (Avalon I, Madrone and Radiance, re-checked against data/raw/parcels.geojson in the 2026-09 audit; Avalon II and III are not condo-mapped, and Arden and One Mission Bay were not re-checked).'.
properties.accuracy_caveat: REAL -- surveyed OpenStreetMap building footprint(s), not a hand trace or plan estimate. The underlying Assessor parcel is condo-mapped across many individually owned per-unit lots (confirmed against DataSF's Assessor parcel data), so no single blklot represents the whole building and the building cannot be mapped from a single Assessor parcel the way a single-owner building can. Using the real building footprint from OSM instead of a fabricated or arbitrarily chosen 'representative' unit lot, the same pattern already used for Mission Bay's other condo-mapped residential towers (Avalon I, Madrone and Radiance, re-checked against the same parcel data in September 2026; Avalon II and III are not condo-mapped, and Arden and One Mission Bay were not re-checked).
properties.notes: 99 lofts and condominium units and the architect (McLarand Vasquez Emsiek & Partners) per Signature Development Group's project page; the OSM relation itself gives only building=yes.
